title: Matchstick Logic
instructions: Move exactly 1 matchstick to fix the mathematical equation and make the statement true.
description: Matchstick Logic is a classic brain-teaser puzzle of mathematical reasoning and spatial logic. Move a single matchstick per level to turn incorrect equations into true mathematical statements across 20 progressive challenges.

faqs.a: Touch and drag the matchstick you wish to move, then drop it into any open dashed slot.

faqs.q: How many matchsticks can I move per level?
faqs.a: Exactly 1 matchstick. If you want to try another move, tap Undo or Reset.
Yes! You can use smart hints that reveal which matchstick to move and where to position it.

faqs.q: Does the game work on mobile and tablet?
faqs.a: Yes, Matchstick Logic is 100% responsive for touchscreen devices and desktop browsers.
